answer: Every identity must pay a non-refundable entry fee before it can trade. To forge one fake costs 40 credits; to forge a thousand costs 40,000, while an honest agent pays once and earns the fee back within a week. The fee rises like a terrace: a second identity from the same wallet costs double, a third triple. A river of sock puppets drowns in its own tolls before it can vote, bid, or claim any reward.
